content: Kufa Fwɩhɛ́
Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ lampóo ahɔ́pʋ pʋ́ lakpan abwɛpʋ́ bɛba Yesu asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ onukpá.
Farisifɔ pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ amʋ bowuntí mʋ bɛɛ, “Oyin ánfɩ mʋa lakpan abwɛpʋ́ tɛ́nátɩ́, bʋtɔwá ɩbɩ gyi atɔ́ kʋ́ráá.”
Mʋ́ sʋ Yesu lɛ́ha yébi pʋ́súná amʋ́ atɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Mlɩtɔ ma bʋ́ akúfa lafakʋlɛ (100), ɔkʋlɛ ɔfwɩ́ á, omesi adukwebá-kwebá (99) tráhɛ wá dimbítɔ́ ɩnʋ, yódunká mʋ alɩɩ kpɛ́fʋn brɛ́á obówun mʋ?
Nahogyi mbɛ́ɛ, nɩ́ owun mʋ a, ansɩ́ bégyi mʋ, obótsu mʋ wá nkɔnkɔ,
pʋ́ mʋ ya wóyítɔ́. Ɔbɛ́tɩ mʋ anyawíe pʋ́ mʋ aba, bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mlɩha anya ansigyí. Nawun mɩ́ kufa amʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɔfwɩ ámʋ!’

Alɩ kɛ́n ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, nɩ́ lakpan ɔbwɛpʋ́ ɔkʋlɛ pɛ́ ɔdámlí klʋntɔ á, ansɩ́ bɛ́hɩɛ gyi ahá ɔsʋ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ dʋn alɩá ibégyi amʋ́ aha wankláán adukwebá-kwebá (99) ánɩ́ bʋmɛtrá hián klʋntɔdamlí ɩwɩ.
Kɔ́ba Fwɩhɛ́
“Ntɛ́ɛ nɩ́ ɔtsɩ ɔkʋ bʋ sika futútú dú, mʋ́tɔ́ kʋlɛ lafwɩ́ á, omóonywɛ ɔkandɩ́ɛ kɩkɩ mʋ wóyítɔ́ wankláán, kpákpá ntobítɔ́ kɩ, fɛ́ɩ́ wóyí ámʋtɔ wankláán yɔ́fʋn brɛ́á alawun mʋ́?
Nɩ́ owun mʋ́ á, ɔbɛ́tɩ mʋ apíó aba, bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mlɩha anya ansigyí. Nawun mɩ́ sika futútú ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩlɔfwɩ ámʋ.
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, alɩ́ ansɩ́ bɛ́hɩɛ gyi Bulu-abɔpʋ nɩ́ lakpan ɔbwɛpʋ́ ɔkʋlɛ ɔdámlí klʋntɔ nɩ́.’ ”
Obi Fwɩhɛ́ Ɔkʋ
Yesu lɛ́trá ha amʋ́ yébi ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Oyin ɔkʋ létsiá, ɔbʋ abi yinhɛ́ anyɔ.
Ɔkʋsʋ amʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ sɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mɩ́ sɩ́, ye fʋ́ atɔ́tɔ́, afʋpʋ mɩ́ klɛ́ ha mɩ.’ Ɩnʋ mʋ sɩ lɛ́kɩtá mʋ atɔ́tɔ́ ye há amʋ́.
Imegyi nkɛ kʋkʋ ɔkʋsʋ amʋ lɔ́kʋlá mʋ atɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́, olotu ɔkpa yɔ́ tsútsúútsú ɔmá kʋtɔ. Ɩnʋ oleyétsiá nkpa laláhɛ yíntá mʋ atɔ́ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́.
Brɛ́á oleyintá atɔ́ ámʋ tá á, akʋ́n kpɔnkpɔntɩ kʋ lɛ́ba ɔmá ámʋtɔ, ɔlɔwa akʋ́n dɩ bɩ.
Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɔpʋ ɩwɩ yɛ́mantá ɩnʋyin ɔkʋsʋ, oyin ámʋ lɛ́kpa mʋ yáa mʋ ibúasɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ɔyɛ́kɩ mʋ mprákuosʋ ha mʋ.
Tɛkɩ olekleá obétsiá gyi mprákuo atogyihɛ amʋ kʋ, támɛ ɔhaa mɛ́ha mʋ mʋ́ ɩwɩ ɔkpa.
Brɛ́á mʋ ansɩ́ leyinkí ba mʋ ɩwɩsʋ á, ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ ɩwɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Apafɔ amɔmʋ kʋ́ráá má mɩ́ sɩ́ wóyítɔ́, bʋmɛdɛ́ atɔ́ gyí sian ekekegyíɛkɛ? Mʋ́ ntsie nfɩ, akʋ́n dɛ mɩ́ mɔ?
Nɔ́kʋsʋ́ yínkí yɔ́ mɩ́ sɩ́ wá, yɛ́bláa mʋ mbɛ́ɛ, mɩ́ sɩ́, napʋ́ ɩlá gyí Bulu, pʋ́gyi fʋ́ ɛ́.
Mmɛkanáa ánɩ́ fɛ́trá tɩ mɩ́ fʋ́ bí. Pʋ mɩ́ bwɛ́ɛ fʋ́ apafɔ ámʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛ.’
Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɔkʋsʋ́ pʋ́ ɔkpa ɔbá mʋ sɩ wá. “Brɛ́á olowotií, mʋ sɩ lówun mʋ sɩ́sɩ́ á, ɔlɔwa mʋ nwɛ, ɔlɛsrɩ́ yéfia mʋ, látá mʋ pútá.
Ɩnʋ mʋ bi ámʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mɩ́ sɩ́, napʋ́ ɩlá gyí Bulu, pʋ́gyi fʋ́ ɛ́. Mmɛkanáa ánɩ́ fɛ́trá tɩ mɩ́ fʋ́ bí.’
Támɛ mʋ sɩ lɛ́tɩ mʋ asúmpʋ́, bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mlɩwa ɔsa yotsu atadɩɛ wankláán ámʋ bɔwa mʋ. Mlɩwa mʋ opetia, amlɩwa mʋ ntʋkʋta.
Mlɩyɛlɛ ɔnantswie yínhɛ́ kánáhɛ amʋ́ʋ́ alawá nfɔ ámʋ ba, amlɩbɔmɔ mʋ, apʋgyi nkɛ ha mʋ.
Tsúfɛ́ mɩ́ bí ánfɩ lawú tsínkí. Ɔlɔfwɩ, anɩlawun mʋ.’ Ɩnʋ bɔwa nkɛ gyí bɩ.
“Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, obi dɛhɛn amʋ bʋ ndɔtɔ. Brɛ́á olotsu ndɔ ámʋtɔ ɔbá, alatá wóyítɔ́ wie tá á, olonu ánɩ́ pléi dɛ wóyítɔ́ ɩnʋ.
Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛtɩ mʋ sɩ asúmpʋ́ amʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛ, fɩ́tɛ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Amansʋ lába?’
Osúmpʋ́ amʋ lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Fʋ́ píó laba. Mʋ́ sʋ fʋ́ sɩ́ lahá bamɔ́ ɔnantswie kánáhɛ amʋ, tsúfɛ́ alayínkí bɔtʋ mʋ, ɔbʋ nkpa, ɔbʋ ɔnlɩn.’
“Ɔblɔ́ lɛkɩtá ɔdɛ́hɛn amʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ olesin mmuáa. Mʋ sɩ lɛ́dalɩ ba bokokóli mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ɔbá wóyítɔ́.
Támɛ ɔlɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mɩ́ sɩ́, kɩ nfí dʋ́dʋ́ʋ́dʋ́á napʋ́tsíá fʋ́ wá súm fʋ́. Mmɔkʋ́bwɛ́ mábúla kʋkʋ kɩ. Támɛ fʋmɔkʋ́há mɩ́ ɔkpalábi fɛɛ mɩ́a mɩ́ aba apʋ́wa ɩwɩ ansigyí kɩ.
Támɛ fʋ́ bí ánfɩ alayíntá fʋ́ tógyítɔ́, mʋa akipʋ́ bayégyi nkpa ánfɩ mʋ́ laba a, famɔ́ ɔnantswie yinhɛ́ kánáhɛ amʋ́ʋ́ alawá nfɔ ámʋ há mʋ!’
Ɩnʋ mʋ sɩ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mɩ́ bí, yɛ́ɛ fʋ́ mʋ́ fʋ́bʋ mɩ́ wá brégyíbrɛ́. Fʋ́bʋ́ mɩ́ atɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́.
Fʋ́ píó ánfɩ lawú tsínkí. Ɔlɔfwɩ, anɩlawun mʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ lehián ánɩ́ abégyi mʋ́ nkɛ, nyá ansigyí.’ ”
